[p]Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes; from classic equipment to innovative multiple units, unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6! 
[/p][p][/p][p][b]ALL ABOARD FOR HOBOKEN[/b][/p][p][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/dda00cc365a08db99ad3bf03b4b18888.poster.avif?t=1785938614" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/dda00cc365a08db99ad3bf03b4b18888.webm?t=1785938614" width="780" height="150"][/imgvid][/p][p] [/p][p]Discover the electrified network of NJ TRANSIT® with the MORRISTOWN LINE. March across the Morris & Essex County suburbs and dart between the Big Apple and the commuter town of Dover aboard the classic Arrow III EMU, or the ALP-46 & MultiLevel cars. 
[/p][p]DELUXE EDITION: Power up prime movers or position the pantograph, take control of the versatile NJ TRANSIT® ALP-45DP on additional and bustling commuter services. 
[/p][p][/p][p][b]THE ENGLISH RIVIERA[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]
[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/701c210cff29fc087a361f970e1d7838.poster.avif?t=1785938614" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/701c210cff29fc087a361f970e1d7838.webm?t=1785938614" width="780" height="150"][/imgvid][/p][p] [/p][p]Dive down the Devon Banks and soar along the Dawlish Sea Wall with the legendary RIVIERA LINE. Drive GWR services bound for idyllic English coastal towns between Exeter, Plymouth & Paignton aboard the “Intercity” Class 802 and Class 150/2 “Sprinter”. 
[/p][p]DELUXE EDITION: Go on a long-distance voyage in the CROSSCOUNTRY BR CLASS 220. Drive additional services over the hills to Plymouth & Paignton. 
[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEXT STOP: LEIPZIG[/b][/p][p][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/6730c847bd94cc2b8ee7145cf366e9f7.poster.avif?t=1785938614" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/6730c847bd94cc2b8ee7145cf366e9f7.webm?t=1785938614" width="780" height="150"][/imgvid][/p][p] [/p][p]Go beyond the boundaries of Nahverkehr Dresden and accelerate westbound all the way to Leipzig in BAHNSTRECKE LEIPZIG - DRESDEN. Drive modern ICE-T, BR 442 and loco-hauled passenger trains, as well as freight, along the oldest long-distance railway in Germany. 
[/p][p]DELUXE EDITION: Venerable shunting traction drives into the yards of Germany; the iconic DB BR 294 is ready for service! Assemble trains and take them across the mainline with classic diesel power. 
[/p][p][/p][p][b]EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED[/b][/p][p][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/823bd31cb0647deb55f2c3dd48f63f9c.poster.avif?t=1785938614" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/823bd31cb0647deb55f2c3dd48f63f9c.webm?t=1785938614" width="780" height="150"][/imgvid][/p][p] [/p][p]The next station is… ANNOUNCEMENTS! Listen out both on platforms & trains for audible details of every journey. Be further immersed inside trains with added passenger ambience. Be ready for RANDOM EVENTS & FAULTS, signals may take longer to clear, speed restrictions could be in place, or equipment failures on your train may need resolving. 
[/p][p][/p][p][b]THE RAILS ARE YOURS[/b][/p][p][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/575e6d2c368f17279f08cda02c2c131e.poster.avif?t=1785938614" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/575e6d2c368f17279f08cda02c2c131e.webm?t=1785938614" width="780" height="150"][/imgvid][/p][p] [/p][p]With a diverse array of features such as Photo Mode, Route Hopping and more, embark on your own journey, in your own way.  
[/p][p]FREE ROAM: Choose your path and explore any route with your favourite trains! Have the rails entirely to yourself or mix in with the timetable, running between scheduled services on your own ad hoc journeys. 
[/p][p]CONDUCTOR MODE: Tickets please! Enjoy a different pace on conductor-operated trains - check tickets between each station and work the passenger doors to safely dispatch your service. Take a moment to enjoy the scenery on longer stretches between stations. 
[/p][p]CREATORS CLUB: Get creative and customise your experience! Use LIVERY DESIGNER to make your dream designs come to life, and FORMATION DESIGNER to make up custom trains using your collection. Put creations to use with Free Roam & SCENARIO PLANNER, or share your creations online! (Dovetail Live sign-up required). 
[/p][p] [/p][p][b]YOUR COLLECTION, YOUR WAY[/b][/p][p]  
[/p][p]Enter the hobby with different editions: 
[/p][p]FREE STARTER PACK introduces you to Train Sim World 6 with the Training Center. [/p][p][/p][p]STANDARD EDITION comes with the 3 new routes, DELUXE EDITION also comes with additional new trains, and SPECIAL EDITION comes with an additional set of TSW6 Compatible routes.[/p][p][/p][p][img width="1560" height="878"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/e7bcd578835fa3f8cddbf9774bbb13f2.avif?t=1785938614[/img][img width="1560" height="878"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/c11880f275382caa118956dfeb79e2e5.avif?t=1785938614[/img][img width="1560" height="878"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/427312c17b07ee368dbae1adac7bfba8.avif?t=1785938614[/img][/p][p]“TSW Compatible” content released for a previous Train Sim World - features may remain unchanged from the original release and may not make use of all newer core features.[/p][p] [/p][p]Kick-start your railway hobby with everyone’s favourite Tank Engine. Train Sim World 6: Thomas & Friends™ Edition gives you everything you need to enjoy the Thomas & Friends™ Visit the West Somerset Railway add-on and 80th Anniversary Expansion - drive beloved characters in story-based adventures! 
[/p][p][img width="1414" height="464"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3656800/extras/c2b1e5dc5d61dd4bced1f30a0a4bb7a6.avif?t=1785938614[/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Look forward to a great variety of experiences from multiple countries. Explore the many existing routes and locos and get ready for new challenges as the world of train simulation ever expands. 
[/p][p]With any upgrades from a previous Train Sim World – your content comes with you! 
[/p][p][/p][p][i]Please Note: The Train Sim World 6 UI is localised into English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. Localisation on Add-On content varies depending on the individual content.[/i]
 
[/p]
data.strSnippet: Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes. Unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6!
